hypotheses.reasoning: event-processor (v4.23.8) crashes deterministically on message msg-476560 at events.raw offset 720765. The consumer hits a recursion limit / RangeError (stack overflow) in expandReferences on that message (#2908, #2968, #3062, #3240). Because the offset is never committed past it, each restart (backoff 10s to 80s, restarts 1-4 at #2910, #2970, #3067, #3241) resumes at the same committed offset 720765 (#2949, #3047, #3211, #3492) and crashes on the same message. The consumer group therefore stops advancing, and events.raw lag climbs from ~1.3k to ~20k (#3135 through #5404), which is the alert. Processing was healthy right up to this offset (#2894 batch OK), so the trigger is the single malformed/self-referencing payload, not load or a deploy. The 14:59:04 restart (#3488) also resumed at the same offset with no further progress. Payment-svc card-processor timeouts and api-gateway 503s on /checkout (#3542, #3766, #3921, #3994) are a separate downstream effect on order-service and not the cause of the crash loop. The metrics-agent queue drops and report-cron pandas ModuleNotFoundError (#3019 onward) are unrelated noise.

verdict.recommendedAction: Quarantine or skip the poison message msg-476560 at events.raw offset 720765: move it to a dead-letter topic, or advance the event-processor consumer group offset past 720765 after capturing the payload. Then add a depth guard or iterative implementation to expandReferences to handle circular or very deep references, and make the consumer dead-letter messages that throw instead of crashing. Separately, investigate the card-processor timeouts behind payment-svc and the order-service checkout 503s, and fix the report-cron image missing pandas.
